answer: A bridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wander of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the voyage of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
